dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Spencer is at risk for behavior concerns. Spencer has been tense and have a lower tollerance for handling. During his assessment ended early after he snapped at the assessor. Outside of the kennel, Spencer has been observed to be non reactive to dogs and people. Medically, Spencer arrived to us matted and an ingrown dew claw. These concerns have been treated and Spencer is otherwise healthy.

Spencer arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, he has been observed to be fearful. Noted to growl and vocalize before charging towards the handler. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Spencer
